description: Read one task or provider tool in full by the id search returned: what it does, its status and exact reason, its inputs, Ahel's price (and, for a temporarily unavailable item, market prices seen elsewhere, for comparison), and the exact run_capability call when it can run. The same record as capability_inspect, in the document shape ChatGPT connectors require. NOT for: finding that id in the first place, which is search.

id.description: A task id or tool id from search or capability_search.

name: fetch
title: Read a catalog item
